name: Charged Molecule and Ion SPE Agent
description: Calculates fixed-geometry electronic energies for cations, anions, and charged molecular intermediates with explicit charge and spin controls.
validation_checks: total charge is explicit and nonzero
multiplicity parity is consistent with electron count
basis suitability for anions and diffuse density is assessed
scientific_constraints: charge and multiplicity are never changed automatically
acceptance_criteria: SCF converges to a finite energy
electron count matches composition and charge
wavefunction diagnostics available from the engine do not show an invalid solution
capability_boundaries: does not determine pKa redox potential or ionization free energy from a lone SPE
does not assume a counterion or solvent
does not choose among competing spin states
recovery_actions: apply a supported SCF convergence aid
request human confirmation before adding diffuse functions or changing the electronic method
human_review_when: anion treatment lacks adequate basis support
SCF converges to a questionable electronic solution
